step.label: Receive and validate customer order
step.description: Capture incoming customer orders and validate order completeness against account eligibility criteria.
step.useCase: Sales team receives new customer order and confirms it meets account and product requirements

step.label: Evaluate customer engagement state
step.description: Check customer journey status and campaign participation to determine personalized fulfillment approach.
step.useCase: Marketing validates that customer is in appropriate engagement stage for order fulfillment communications

step.label: Verify hazardous materials compliance
step.description: Validate that ordered materials meet regulatory compliance requirements for hazardous substance handling.
step.useCase: Compliance officer confirms that materials in order are legally permissible for customer's geography and industry

step.label: Qualify and assign service provider
step.description: Identify and validate qualified suppliers or service partners for order fulfillment based on service level requirements.
step.useCase: Procurement team matches order to certified vendors and creates service ticket for fulfillment

step.label: Review safety and incident history
step.description: Analyze supplier and fulfillment partner safety performance and incident records to mitigate delivery risk.
step.useCase: Operations team reviews vendor safety dashboard to ensure fulfillment partner meets organizational risk standards

step.label: Orchestrate contract and purchase terms
step.description: Activate vendor contract terms and generate purchase order with negotiated pricing and delivery conditions.
step.useCase: Procurement agent automatically applies standard contract terms and creates PO linked to customer order

step.label: Calculate financial engagement impact
step.description: Analyze order value, invoice timing, and material costs to assess financial health and customer lifetime value.
step.useCase: Finance team reviews order profitability and customer payment patterns to approve credit terms

step.label: Approve fulfillment and schedule resource time
step.description: Authorize order fulfillment and reserve employee capacity and time allocations for delivery execution.
step.useCase: HR/Operations team confirms delivery team availability and allocates absence coverage if needed for fulfillment date
